fields.title: Calculating Request Cost
fields.keyTakeaway: Unit cost turns infrastructure costs into an argument for product decisions, and its main user is the person deciding to add a call to a frequent scenario.
fields.sections/0/blocks/0/text: How much does it cost to show the main screen to one person?
fields.sections/1/blocks/0/text: Infrastructure costs are usually discussed as a total sum and are not tied to product decisions. As a result, a feature that doubles maintenance costs is evaluated solely by development time.
fields.sections/2/blocks/0/text: [[unit-cost|Unit cost]] is calculated by division: costs for a period divided by the number of units for the same period.
fields.sections/2/blocks/1/text: What is included in costs: compute resources, storage, traffic, external services, licenses. What is not included: team, office—that is a separate layer.
fields.sections/2/blocks/2/text: A practical approach is to calculate by major components without trying to distribute everything precisely:
fields.sections/2/blocks/3/items/1: Split into groups: compute, storage, traffic, external calls.
fields.sections/2/blocks/3/items/2: Divide each group by the corresponding unit.
fields.sections/2/blocks/5/text: **Cost per request**—for decisions on whether to add a call. **[[cost-per-active-user|Cost per active user]]**—for unit economics. **Cost per order or transaction**—for comparison with commission.
fields.sections/2/blocks/6/text: **External calls** are calculated separately: they are often more expensive than own resources and grow strictly proportionally. A geocoding call, SMS, payment provider call—direct money for every action.
fields.sections/2/blocks/7/text: Product application: **before adding a call to a frequent scenario, its annual cost is calculated.** A call worth 0.02 rubles in a screen opened 340k times a day is 2.5M a year.
fields.sections/3/blocks/2/text: External calls separately: SMS 4.2 RUB, geocoding 0.3 RUB, payment provider 1.2% of the amount.
fields.sections/3/blocks/3/text: Order cost: 1.35M / 600k orders = 2.25 RUB infrastructure plus SMS 4.2 RUB plus provider commission ~29 RUB at an average check of 2,400. Total about 35 RUB with our commission of 96 RUB.
fields.sections/3/blocks/4/text: The calculation changed two decisions. SMS confirmation was replaced with push where the app is installed—saving about 1.8M a year. And we abandoned the idea of checking the address via geocoding on every cart change: 0.3 RUB × 8 changes × 600k orders = 1.4M a year for a feature that can be called once.
fields.sections/4/blocks/0/text: Exact cost allocation by features is usually impossible and unnecessary. An order of magnitude is enough for decisions on whether to add a frequent call.
fields.sections/5/blocks/0/text: Unit cost turns infrastructure costs into an argument for product decisions, and its main user is the person deciding to add a call to a frequent scenario.
